title: Countdown to a date or event
when: The user wants a countdown showing days, hours, minutes and seconds until an event, launch, birthday or deadline.
prompt:
Goal: A countdown that is exact in local time, ticks on whole seconds and handles the moment it reaches zero.
Steps:
1. Labeled event name and datetime-local inputs; several countdowns saved in localStorage guarded and listed nearest first.
2. logic.mjs: parseLocal(str) builds new Date(y, m - 1, d, h, min) from parts; diffParts(target, now) returns { days, hours, minutes, seconds, past }.
3. Four labeled blocks (Days, Hours, Minutes, Seconds); schedule with setTimeout(tick, 1000 - Date.now() % 1000) to stay on the second.
4. Say "local time"; computing from epoch ms keeps daylight saving changes right.
5. At zero stop, show the event message in role="status"; a celebration animation only without prefers-reduced-motion.
6. Past events show "3 days ago" and can be deleted.
7. test.mjs: known pairs, past dates, across a month end.
Quality bar:
- No drift after an hour open.
- Numbers pad to two digits.
- Readable at 375 px.
Pitfalls:
- Date.parse on "2026-12-31 20:00", which differs between engines.
- Negative numbers after the deadline.
- Announcing every second.
Verify:
- [ ] Diff math tested.
- [ ] Reduced motion rule present.
- [ ] Inputs labeled.
- [ ] node test.mjs passes.
Output: index.html, style.css, app.js, logic.mjs (date math), test.mjs.

examples.output: blocks 128 days 04:12:09, message "Hoje e o grande dia" at zero
